propositions: DC 8.17.1 was reported to reject 255-character labels while accepting 254, conflicting with rebar's shared JIRA_LABEL_MAX_CHARS constant set to 255
Cloud's documented 255-character label limit was never measured live; this ticket required direct verification against a real Cloud instance before architectural changes
sanitize_label raises InvalidLabelError above the ceiling rather than truncating, causing a shared 254-character limit to reject valid 255-character labels on Cloud
Live measurement on navasage.atlassian.net confirmed Cloud accepts and round-trips 255-character labels identically to DC, eliminating the reported divergence

The raise-vs-truncate behavior difference between sanitize_label and sanitize_summary is intentional: labels are identity tokens that must not be silently altered, while summaries are prose where truncation is acceptable
